data_type_or_values: tab-delimited text with header; 26,169 data rows and 12 columns
description: Gene annotation and historical transcriptional-pattern cross-reference table for retained PN40024 v4 grapevine genes.
method_or_interpretation: Despite the .csv extension, fields are separated by TAB characters. Read with sep='\\t' or equivalent.

description: PN40024 v4 Ensembl grapevine gene identifier.
method_or_interpretation: Genes were retained after read-count filtering; the manuscript reports 26,169 retained protein-coding genes.

description: UniProt accession mapped to the grapevine gene.
Matched gene or feature identifier from NCBI assembly GCA_030704535.1 (ASM3070453v1).
PN40024 v4 chromosome or scaffold assignment.
method_or_interpretation: Values may include numbered chromosomes or Un for unplaced sequence.

description: Gene start coordinate on the reported PN40024 v4 chromosome or scaffold.
Gene end coordinate on the reported PN40024 v4 chromosome or scaffold.

data_type_or_values: three groups of three-character codes using U, D, E
description: Historical time-resolved differential-transcription patterns for Rpv12, Rpv12+Rpv1, and Rpv12+Rpv1+Rpv3, in that order.
method_or_interpretation: Within each genotype, positions correspond to 0, 6, and 24 hpi. U = upregulated, D = downregulated, E = equivalent to susceptible. Historical calls used FDR < 0.05 and absolute log2 fold change > 1.

description: Description of the selected Arabidopsis thaliana TAIR10 homolog, usually including protein accession and name.
method_or_interpretation: Homology relationships were obtained by BLASTP against Arabidopsis proteins; the manuscript reports an e-value cutoff < 1e-6.

description: Amino-acid sequence identity or homology percentage for the selected Arabidopsis match.
method_or_interpretation: Higher values indicate greater sequence similarity.

description: TAIR10/NCBI protein accession of the selected Arabidopsis homolog.
Common gene symbol or short name for the Arabidopsis homolog.
method_or_interpretation: The unusual capitalization is part of the source header. NA indicates that no common name was assigned.

description: Arabidopsis locus identifier, for example AT3G54720.
Expression is significantly higher in the resistant genotype than in susceptible at the corresponding time point.
method_or_interpretation: Historical threshold: FDR < 0.05 and log2 fold change > 1.

description: Expression is significantly lower in the resistant genotype than in susceptible at the corresponding time point.
method_or_interpretation: Historical threshold: FDR < 0.05 and log2 fold change < -1.

description: The gene does not meet both the historical FDR and effect-size thresholds at the corresponding time point.
method_or_interpretation: E is a statistical reference state, not proof of identical expression.

description: Reads were mapped to Vitis vinifera PN40024 v4 with STAR v2.7.4a and counted per gene with featureCounts/Subread v2.0.3.
method_or_interpretation: Gene and protein annotations were assembled from multiple resources.

description: Protein sequence comparison was used to select Arabidopsis thaliana homologs and transfer identifiers/names.
method_or_interpretation: Functional similarity should not be inferred solely from sequence identity.
